description:
BEDLAM SKUNKWORKS

aka my collection of kitbashed ships

After years of enjoying the game I've finally gathered the courage to try and contribute to the community.

Ships:

Currently consisting of only 9 ships, but I plan on making more in the future, as well as implementing other kinds of content in the future. But I am very much new to modding and am learning as I go, so please be patient with me.

Changelog:

Spoiler
1.8.6:

Broadliner buffs, forgor the exact numbers but should be substantial but hopefully not overpowered.

1.8.5:

Fixed hovering over the hullmod tooltip causing a CTD

1.8.4:

Added the Imperator Mk. X, along with its custom, albeit simple, weapons and hullmod. this is totally new ground for me so do let me know if something is wrong!

1.8.3:

Added the Duopoly Mk. X class carrier.

1.8.2:

reworked the Buzzard, again.

1.8.1:

Various small stat buffs. Changed the Broadliner's system from Accelerated Ammo Feed to Temporal Shell.

1.8.0:

reworked the Colossus Mk. X, The front is now an armor module

1.7.0:

Added the Longlash Mk. X

Cleaned up and adjusted .faction file and default_ship-roles.json

1.6.0:
added the Broadliner Mk. X.

I have a feeling that it might be in need of tweaks/rebalancing in the future, so please let me know down below if it needs to be made stronger/weaker

1.5.0:
added the Paraglider Mk. X, because I needed rehab from making cruisers nonstop.

1.4.1:
fixed absolute filepath in .ship file, causing a CTD, again. Should never happen again because I integrated an automated check/fix for it in the script I use to automate my github releases.

1.4.0:
Added the Monkeywrench Mk. X! Extremely fast, extremely brittle.

1.3.0:
Buzzard Mk. X reworked because the old sprite was trash, even by my standards.
Added weapon groups to the variants (jfc how did I miss those?)

1.2.0:

Changed .ship files to use relative filepaths (sorry about that!)
Implemented Version Checker

1.1.0:

Hopefully fixed csv encoding

New ship: Buzzard Mk. X

Colossus Mk. X:
hp 6000 -> 6900
max flux 3250 -> 4250
flux dissipation 180 -> 200
base value 50000 -> 60000
supplies/rec 8 -> 10
supplies/mo 8 -> 10

Atlas Mk. X:
max flux 4000 -> 5000
flux dissipation 200 -> 250
base value 75000 -> 85000
max burn 6 -> 7

1.0:

initial release

Download: https://github.com/HoboG0blin/Bedlam-Skunkworks/releases

Also if you have any balancing suggestions or other ideas feel free to let me know down below!

discordPostHtml:
After playing the game for years I finally decided to give making mods a try. Only contains the two ships so far, but I'm planning on making more in the future, and hopefully expanding to other kinds of content, like weapons, wings and such.

I'm still very much new to modding and learning as I go so please be patient with me.

Download: https://github.com/HoboG0blin/Bedlam-Skunkworks/releases

Forum Thread: https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=33664.0
